title: C:autonomous-heredity with bounded cells: pcell-mwall-b42, walled particle-catalyst cells from noise (M rim/core 3.9, L 1.5) whose heritable link efficiency is selected through both intrinsic deaths and divisions on 4/4 seeds, with no giant cells
summary: Revision of 20261025T1345-c14-pcell-mwall-claim answering c09's review (one cell held 40-49% of particles): the only change is link production b 0.05 -> 0.042, chosen from fixed-yield screens so that cells stay bounded over the whole capped yield range (b=0.042: 19-24 cells at y 1.0-1.2; b=0.045 at y 1.2: 7 cells, largest 42% of particles). From noise, 4/4 seeds keep 26-30 round walled cells to t=100000, the largest holding 7-8% of in-cell particles (max 18%). labkit on seeds 0/1: M rim/core 3.87/3.91, rim/out 15.8/18.6, 142/150 and 170/174 individuals membrane-like, the L link layer now also passes (1.53/1.50); 17 and 10 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3, 0 merges. Genealogy (4 seeds): 12-18 persistent splits, generation 3-5, 20-40 deaths, 0 merges. With no imposed deaths, mean yield rises to 1.15-1.16 against 0.91-1.03 for the identical-event inert marker; mature-cell deaths sit at the 0.3-1.9th yield percentile (marker 36-43rd) and splits at the 82-89th (marker 38-58th); cells born below the median yield never split (0/4 seeds) and die more often (0.43-1.0 vs 0-0.04).

claims.statement: In pcell-mwall-b42 from an unstructured start (noisy phi, uniform random particle soup, M = 0; pack/seed*/sheet.png t=0), 26-30 discrete round cells of bounded size form (largest cell 7-8% of in-cell particles, 4 seeds), each enclosed by a layer of self-made wall material M that differs from interior and exterior (labkit M rim/core 3.87/3.91, rim/out 15.8/18.6), and they divide (labkit 17 and 10 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3, 0 merges; genealogy 12-18 per run, generation 3-5). A heritable link efficiency that arises by mutation is selected by intrinsic whole-cell deaths and by divisions: deaths at the 0.3-1.9th yield percentile and splits at the 82-89th, against 36-43 and 38-58 for an identical-event inert marker on the same particles, and the population mean rises to 1.15-1.16 against 0.91-1.03 for the marker, on 4/4 seeds.
claims.track: seed 0, labkit track 56 (pack/seed0/lineage.png, tracks.png row 4): generation 4 (29 -> 35 -> 41 -> 51 -> 56, persistent splits at t=23000, 36000, 53000, 62000), walled by its M layer through its birth (mfig_s0.png row 2, split 51 -> [56, 58]) and alive to t=100000 while low-yield cells die

controls_run.H: identical-event inert marker z in the same four runs (selfig.png, data/summary.txt): death percentile 0.36-0.43, split percentile 0.38-0.58, low-born vs high-born death share 0.11-0.39 vs 0-0.25, mean 0.91-1.03
controls_run.B: the M source ablation bm=0 is pcell-yeff-cap (no M; its L layer is 1.32-1.33); c09 ran bm=0 on seed 11 of the parent claim world (20261025T1317-c09-review-mwall/bm0): M flat

claims.limits: M is passive here (no feedback on phi, links or particles); the gate variant in which M does work is 20261025T1430-c14-mwall-gate-work. The dying cells with a recorded birth are few (3-8 per seed); the death and split percentiles use all 12-16 mature deaths and 12-18 splits per seed. Dying cells still lose yield during life (0.94-0.97 at birth -> 0.82-0.88 at death, 69-92% declined), more than in the b=0.05 world; part of the death bias is built within life, though dying cells were already at birth rank 0.01-0.12 (marker 0.14-0.47). The marker drifts down to 0.91 on seed 0. The trait is continuous and capped at an imposed 1.2, and b was tuned to that cap. labkit packs for 2 seeds only; no dt or resolution test of this variant (the b=0.05 world kept its layer and divisions at 1.5x, 20261025T1430-c14-mwall-gate-work/pack_res15).
